name: No-KYC
description: The adversary is leveraging services which do not require know-your-customer (KYC), basically meaning they can use them anonymously.

subtechniques.name: Camera software
subtechniques.description: Specific camera software might be used to bypass KYC-procedures.

procedures.name: Kycnot.me
procedures.description: KYCnot.me is a website containing alternatives for buying, exchanging, trading and using cryptocurrencies without having to disclose their identity, thus preserving the right to privacy. https://kycnot.me/

procedures.name: Shinjiru
procedures.description: Shinjiru is a offshore hosting provider which accepts cryptocurrency payments and provides dedicated servers, web hosting, VPS, Bitcoin hosting. https://www.shinjiru.com/

procedures.name: Ablative Hosting
procedures.description: Ablative Hosting is a hosting provider for Onion services which does not require Know-Your-Customer (KYC)/Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and allows cryptocurrency payments. https://ablative.hosting/
